item.title: Series of potholes from bridge to Brantwood on Erith Road, 10th September
item.description:
Potholes present for well over a year here. They don’t qualify for fixing but we are on an artery road between the A2 and 3 industrial areas. HGVs, tankers, buses and emergency vehicles pass 24/7 and the vibrations shake beds in both front and back of house. Same for all neighbours. Noise is insane!

item.title: Lime hire bike obstructing public footway and tactile paved dropped kerb at the narrow footway and busy crossing at the jct of Newlands Park (A213) , Venner Rd and Lennard Rd, Penge near Penge East Station (NE side)., 10th September
item.description:
Lime hire bike obstructing public footway and tactile paved dropped kerb at the narrow footway and busy crossing at the jct of Newlands Park (A213) , Venner Rd and Lennard Rd, Penge near Penge East Station (NE side). In the interests of blind and partially sighted pedestrians please remove this obstruction. Recent media coverage has publicised the harm to blind etc pedestrians and that Lime bikes have no agreement with Bromley Council to use the public realm for storage, letting and 'return' of their hire bikes. I am not reporting these continuing obstructions to Lime, Forest etc commercial entities etc but to Bromley Council as the responsible Highways Authority for nuisance and hazard abatement in the public interest.

item.title: Dumped furniture and hazardous waste pile outside ground floor flat, 9th September
item.description:
Directly outside the ground-floor window/front garden area beneath the first-floor balcony on 6 Calypso Crescent. A large quantity of bulky waste and furniture has been dumped in the garden area directly up against the building facade. Items include an overturned sofa/armchair, broken office chairs, metal pole fixtures, and loose debris. This pile poses a serious fire hazard as combustible material is stacked directly against residential windows and directly under an upper-story balcony. It also risks attracting vermin. Please arrange for inspection and clearance, or forward to the responsible housing provider/landlord immediately.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Calypso Crescent, Old Kent Road, Greater London
